notes: Level 3: Sela's buggy now parks fully in view, she climbs out at its door and walks up before she speaks.
Level 4: Sela and Tam now walk up into view before they speak, so their lines never come from off screen.
Level 1: each fuel cell crate now holds 3 cells (two more in all), so the dust storm timing works.
Level 2: the floor arrows lead from pod to pod and no longer point at fuelling the reactor.
Level 4: Tam walks up beside the commander before she speaks, so her line never comes from off screen.
Level 5: the goal text now reads 'Keep collecting scrap, hire 2 more guards, and fight defenders to protect our camp till sunrise'.
Level 1: each fuel cell crate now holds 2 cells, and the cells lie under rock you dig off before you can carry them.
Level 2: the pick, guard and KILN lines read right, the commander is in frame for his line, and no gate marker shows before a wall exists.

Level 3: the old kiosk now sits further south-west, out of sight from the dome; it stays dark until the commander says 'Those lights to the south', and then it shows its ruined look with cracked glass.

Level 3: a road runs past the kiosk up to where Sela arrives, scrap heaps use the small scrap model and are spread away from the wrecks, and the hub-build buggy parks beside the hub instead of clipping its corner.

Level 3: story lines are back to the approved wording, with clearer goal text, arrows to the scrap, Tam's offer at the dome after the protein sale, and the commander walking out of the hub so Sela and he share one frame.
Level 4: one gate serves all three newcomers, arrows lead to the flight recorder once the crew is trained, and once trained Tam carries 6 and alternates between the galley and the kiosk.

Level 5: arrows point to the turret and the guard, the turret pad sits north of the turret, the guard pad sits outside the gate, the gate camera frames where the settlers arrive, and the coin counter shows on the HUD.
Characters stand still while a story line is up and carry on afterwards; the caption follows Sela in the buggy; guide arrows sit above the floor tiles and follow the light day or night.
Resource chips stack vertically on the HUD, and the story star row now reads star x/y above three stars.
Story scenes, the spirit portrait and the asset table now release their graphics memory when closed.
Level 3: the kiosk now comes on at night still ruined, then is restored with a short fade when you stock its first greens; Levels 4 and 5 start with the repaired kiosk.
Level 3: Sela, Tam, Rhee and Okafor now walk up beside the commander and speak on screen, and Sela's caption follows her instead of the parked buggy.
Levels 1-5: the star row at the top is back to ordinary stars; the Levels menu shows a star count like 3/7 on levels with many stars so it fits the card.
Levels 1-5: the commander, crew and Sela's buggy now stand perfectly still while a story line is on screen, with no walking or running steps and no sliding.
Levels 1-5: coins and dropped scrap no longer dip under the floor tiles.
Level 5: only one gate is left in the wall (the extra one is gone), and the guard price on the pad shows a scrap piece instead of a round coin.
Level 3: Sela drives all the way into view, stops, and steps out of the buggy before she says a word, and the screen is only held while she arrives.
Level 3: Okafor, Rhee and Tam now walk in from just off the edge of the screen and stop beside the commander, turned to him, before they speak; no long waiting while they walk up.
Level 3: the guide arrows follow what you are doing (scrap, greens, wall, rockslide, hoppers, coins, hub) and no longer point at the grow dome after the rockslide dig.
Level 3: when the hub is built, Sela's buggy drives up beside the commander, she congratulates you and hands over the Halcyon chip, and the blank card at the end is gone.
Levels 3-5: Rhee's aid station (the med crate and lamp) is gone.
Levels 1-5: one scene mode now holds everyone still whenever a story scene plays (lines, walk-ons, camera moves), and a new story trace checks every scene before it ships.
Level 2: when Pip, Rhee, Okafor or Tam speak after their pod comes home, they now walk in beside you first instead of talking from off screen.

Level 5: the settlers are shown at the gate when they ask to be let in, Okafor and the lieutenant step on screen before they speak, and the arrows lead to scrap and then the guard pad. The goal now says hire 1 more guard.
